title: Best space and sci-fi themed Halloween costumes for 2026
summary: It's never too early to plan your Halloween outfit — here are some of the best space-themed Halloween costumes on the web.
contentText:
Are you stuck for an outfit this spooky season? We've got you covered with our round-up of the best space themed Halloween costumes. Let's face it, even if there aren't any haunted spaceships out there, the vastness of the void is enough to give us the chills.

From Aliens to Star Wars, these costumes are sure to make you stand out, get the conversation flowing and maybe even raise a chuckle or two. And if you're a regular convention-goer, many of these costumes can double as cosplay outfits.

If you're still struggling for inspiration, or want to put your own costume together from scratch, you can always check out the best lightsabers , best streaming services or the best Lego Star Wars and Lego Marvel sets for ideas.

The quick list

Best overall

Alien chestburster crew

The best overall

Surprise and shock friends and family with this Alien costume, which makes you an unfortunate member of the ill-fated Nostromo crew, complete with a 3D chestburster Alien tearing its way out of your torso. The gruesome t-shirt alone is enough to turn heads.

Best for Star Wars fans

Jedi robes

The best for Star Wars fans

Who doesn't love pretending they're in Star Wars? With this Jedi outfit, you can do just that this Halloween. Pair it with a lightsaber and people may have to do a double-take.

Best for nostalgia

Captain Kirk shirt

The best for nostalgia

I used to love watching Star Trek with my Grandad on a Saturday afternoon and finding this shirt brings back memories. For fans of the Original Series, this is a must-have for Halloween.

Best for women

Princess Leia

The best for women

This is a little obvious, I know, but I still think it's a great outfit for women to wear on Halloween. Plus, who can argue that Princess Leia isn't cool? Why not celebrate a strong woman this Halloween and become her for the day?

Best comedy

Inflatable spaceship costume

The best comedy costume

Blast off with this super-silly costume which, with the aid of a pair of inflatable false legs, gives the impression you're heading to the stars.

Best villain

Darth Vader

The best villain

What is Halloween without someone dressing up as a villain? That could be your child this year with this great Darth Vader costume, including everything they need to become evil for the day.

Best for young kids

Rocket costume

The best for young kids

If you have little ones who want to go trick-or-treating this Halloween and are fans of space, this is the perfect costume for them to wear. As it's a slip-on and slip-off costume, it makes getting ready and out the door a whole lot easier, too.

The best space and sci-fi themed Halloween costumes we recommend in 2026

Amazon Aliens chestbuster crew costume

A wonderfully gruesome Halloween costume that's instantly recognizable

Price: $79.99 | Materials: Cotton/poly/latex | Available sizes: Small to XL | Color options: One color

Realistic

Officially licensed memorabilia

Just the t-shirt is enough

Trousers are not movie-accurate

Not suitable for those with a latex allergy

As sci-fi horror goes, it doesn't get more disturbing than Alien's infamous chestburster scene and now you can cosplay as one of the Nostromo's unfortunate crewmembers, complete with an alien emerging from your torso.

Admittedly, no one in the movie actually wore beige pants, so there's an inaccuracy there, which is odd given this is an officially licensed Alien costume. But the 3D chestburster, a wonderfully gruesome latex model attached to the outfit's t-shirt, more than makes up for that.

In fact, if you're in a hurry, you can forget about the rest of the costume and just slip on the t-shirt; between the creature on your chest and the Nostromo badge on your shoulder, there'll be no mistaking your outfit. And if you're looking for a couples costume, you can snag this Ellen Ripley jumpsuit .

Amazon Jedi robes

A great Halloween and cosplay outfit for fans of the Star Wars saga.

Price: $74.99 to $89.99 | Materials: Cotton | Available sizes: Medium to 3XL, gender neutral design and fit | Color options: Brown/beige, white/beige, black

Cosplay outfit

Detailed design

Gender neutral fit

Expensive for a Halloween costume

This outfit may not bear the official Star Wars name but any fan of the saga will recognize it as the iconic robes of a Jedi, as worn by Obi-Wan Kenobi and virtually every light side wielder of the Force.

This cotton costume has plenty of detail and comes with a set of faux leather pouches, and they're unisex, so you can cosplay as whichever pre-Order 66 Jedi you want. Just add one of the best lightsabers .

But what's especially cool about this outfit is that it can be worn in a variety of ways. The tunic, trousers and cloak are all separate pieces, so you can leap into battle or slip the cloak over your head and lurk in a corner, looking all mysterious.

Those who've purchased this outfit praise its quality, in particular the thickness of the fabric. And if you lean more towards the Dark Side, there's a black Sith version as well.

Rubies Captain Kirk shirt

For anyone with a soft spot for Star Trek: The Original Series.

Price: $49.80 - $58.59 | Materials : Polyester | Available sizes: Small to X-Large, men's only | Color options: Gold

Nostalgic

Simple and fuss-free

Create the whole crew

Embroidery could be better

Sizing can be tricky

Hand wash only

I used to love watching the Original Series with my Grandad on a weekend. I have no idea how old I was but I have fond memories of those times and the many hours spent trying to learn how to do the Vulcan salute. If you're a fan of the Original Series like me, or just the original of anything Sci-Fi, this might be the Halloween costume for you.

Captain Kirk's shirt is a super simple and fuss-free Halloween costume. People will instantly recognize the striking color and design as being that of Captain Kirk. Combining it with a pair of dark pants will really set this costume off.

One great thing about this item is that it's not only a great Halloween costume choice but also an officially licensed product, meaning it's trademarked and authentic — ideal for true Star Trek fans as an item they can keep and wear again and again. Plus, there is the option of creating the full crew with family or friends, with the women's Starfleet dresses also being available.

It's important to note that the product listing advises customers to look at the sizing chart, rather than ordering based on your known sizes. Some people found the fit to be right, while others had to return it and order another size. To avoid this, it's best to consult the size chart. Reviewers also mentioned that the embroidery can be hit and miss, especially around the emblem.

Regardless of this, I think, for the money, this is a decent Halloween costume that will spark memories for those who grew up with the Original Series.

Pouzuwb Princess Leia

One for the women — become a powerful princess for a day.

Price: $45.99 (with wig) | Materials: Cloth and PU leather | Available sizes: Small to 3X-large, women only | Color options: White

Full costume

Machine washable

Versatile costume

Cannot tumble dry

No reviews

This Princess Leia costume is a great option for any Halloween parties you might be attending this year. Whether you're a Star Wars fan or not, this outfit is a classic and allows you to feel like a powerful princess while you're wearing it. You can purchase it with and without the wig — if you buy the wig, there will be no mistaking who you are. It's a simple outfit yet one that everyone will recognize. The attention to detail is good, with it mimicking the outfit worn in the films pretty accurately. So, even if you don't purchase the wig, most people will probably guess who you are dressed up as.
